# sdrtrunk-vce 0.6.2 Alpha 5

Alpha 5 makes updates easier to understand, improves help when something goes wrong, and makes P25 and web-call
information clearer.

This is still alpha software. Stop sdrtrunk-vce and back up its portable `data` folder before replacing an earlier
build.

## Added

- A one-time What's New page appears in the coordinated startup experience the first time you run each new public
  version. It remains available from the Help menu.
- Help > Submit Bug Report lets you describe a problem, attach extra screenshots, and either send the report or save a
  ZIP for manual upload. Before anything is collected, the window explains exactly what is included and requires your
  consent.
- The web player now keeps aliases together with their talkgroup or radio number and shows the system, channel,
  frequency, slot, decoder, protected-call status, and call length when available.

## Changed

- A conventional P25 frequency imported from RadioReference now becomes a P25 Conventional channel instead of a
  trunked P25 control channel.
- Single-frequency P25 entries imported from an older XML playlist are converted to P25 Conventional when they look
  conventional. Entries with strong signs of a trunked system remain trunked. Existing channels in an already-created
  portable database are not changed automatically.
- Compact web tables use familiar hexadecimal radio-system numbers, while detail pages show labeled hexadecimal and
  decimal values together where both are useful.
- Obsolete documentation screenshots were replaced with current desktop and web views. New signal-path and delay
  guidance helps identify where listening latency comes from.

## Fixed

- The browser player now identifies whether a number is a talkgroup, radio, patch, or phone number and keeps the
  source-to-target relationship visible for playing and queued calls.
- Packaged builds retain the exact application version and build details used by diagnostics, making submitted reports
  easier to match to the correct release.

## Before You Download

- No database migration is needed from Alpha 4. Alpha 5 continues to use P25 history schema version 19.
- Replace the application files instead of merging two releases together, and keep your portable `data` folder.
- P25 import improvements affect new RadioReference or legacy-XML imports. Review newly imported channels as usual;
  existing portable-database channels are left alone.
- The bug-report tool includes the current application screenshot, application log, sanitized configuration, exact
  tuner identifiers and serial numbers, hostname, and basic computer details. The report service records the public
  address used for the upload and normally retains a report for 30 days. Recordings, the key vault, passwords, API
  credentials, and security-key material are excluded. Screenshots are not automatically redacted, so review the
  on-screen disclosure before consenting.

## Downloads

Use the package that matches your operating system and processor. Java is included. JMBE remains a separate setup under
Preferences > Decoder > JMBE Audio Library. Verify the downloaded ZIP with `SHA256SUMS.txt` before installing.
